title: facts.json
description: The figures a repository owns, generated from its facts.yaml by `facts generate` (miniapppolis-common-utils). Never edited by hand; `facts check` fails CI when it no longer matches the repository's data.

repo.description: The repository that owns these figures.

value.description: The figure: a count, a value read from a file, or counts by group.

description.description: What the figure is, in a few words.

source.description: What it is computed from, written by the generator.

as_of.description: The day the value last changed (UTC).
